title: 200 missiles launched
title_en: 200 missiles launched
description: the Russian Federation plans to increase the volley of ballistic missiles to 200 missiles at a time, - SBS commander Madyar in an interview with AP. Now Russia can launch up to 77 ballistic missiles. According to Magyar, the threat can be reduced only by strikes on Russian missile production facilities. He also reported that the share of reactive "Shakheds", which are more difficult to shoot down, has increased by 2.5 times in recent weeks.
description_en: the Russian Federation plans to increase the volley of ballistic missiles to 200 missiles at a time, - SBS commander Madyar in an interview with AP. Now Russia can launch up to 77 ballistic missiles. According to Magyar, the threat can be reduced only by strikes on Russian missile production facilities. He also reported that the share of reactive "Shakheds", which are more difficult to shoot down, has increased by 2.5 times in recent weeks.
description_uk: рф планирует увеличить залп баллистики до 200 ракет за раз, — командующий СБС Мадяр в интервью AP Сейчас русня может запускать до 77 баллистических ракет. По словам Мадяра, снизить угрозу можно только ударами по объектам российского ракетного производства. Также он сообщил, что доля реактивных «Шахедов», которые сложнее сбивать, за последние недели выросла в 2,5 раза.
